111: This is [similar to a claim concerning ownership of] land - but we taught in a mishna that we can extend [the oath in such cases]; what additional [concept] is Rav Yehuda teaching us that [a claim of] "you are my slave" is subject to extension [of an oath]?
It would not have generated publicity - therefore the mishna taught that extension [of an oath applies] to it [specifically, but not to a case of a Hebrew slave].
